corrections.corrected_text: ዘፍ ፬ ፰ ዕብ ፲፩ ፬ ፪ዜና ፳፬ ፳፪
corrections.reason: Biblical reference underlines misread as characters: Hebrews 11:4 (ዕብ ፲፩ ፬) and 2 Chronicles 24:22 (፪ዜና ፳፬ ፳፪).
In Ge'ez (1 Enoch 22:7), 'his brother' nominative is 'እኁሁ' (እኁ↵ሁ), with 2nd order ኁ clearly visible at the end of the line.

Looking closely at the image, the printed glyph is 'አግኝተው' (or 'አግኝቶ' / 'አግኝተው' compressed), wait: in the image it has 4 letters: አ-ግ-ኝ-ተ-ው? No, it is 4 letters: አ-ግ-ኝ-ተ? Actually let's check: አ-ግ-ኝ-ቶ! The 7th order ቶ has the top circle/bar.
Canonical Ge'ez Matthew 23:36 and visual check: 'ይበጽሕ ለዛቲ ትውልድ' (6th order ሕ, not 7th order ሖ).
Ge'ez Matthew 23:37 'አስተጋብ↵ኦሙ ለውሉድኪ' (7th order ኦ for the 3rd masc. pl. object suffix -omu).
The word across the line wrap is 'ልጆች↵ዋን' (6th order ች, not 2nd order ቹ).
